item.subject: science
item.stem:
Ira has the circuit in the diagram. There is a gap in the loop. She places a test strip across that gap and closes the switch.

When does the lamp glow?

options.A: The lamp glows even if the strip is a rubber eraser, because the cell is still in the loop.
options.B: The lamp glows when the strip is a metal key, because that closes a conducting path.
options.C: The lamp does not glow with a metal key, because current would have to run the other way around the loop.
options.D: The lamp glows only after the strip has been in the gap for a few minutes.

learn_by_solve.solve: Which lamps light? Required: A — lamp 1 only. B would need “lamp 2 only”, but the item needs “lamp 1 only”. C would need “lamp 1 and lamp 2”, but the item needs “lamp 1 only”. D would need “neither lamp 1 nor lamp 2”, but the item needs “lamp 1 only”.

B.pathway: dropping a stated condition so “lamp 2 only” looked possible instead of “lamp 1 only”

followup.stem: Option B. Is “lamp 2 only” lamps light?

options.B: No — “lamp 2 only” is not lamps light
options.C: “lamp 2 only” is a different quantity or structure in the same item
options.D: “lamp 2 only” would apply to a different process or organism

followup.why: Option B used “lamp 2 only”; the item needs “lamp 1 only”.

C.pathway: dropping a stated condition so “lamp 1 and lamp 2” looked possible instead of “lamp 1 only”

followup.stem: Option C. Is “lamp 1 and lamp 2” lamps light?

options.A: Yes — “lamp 1 and lamp 2” is lamps light
options.B: “lamp 1 and lamp 2” is a different quantity or structure in the same item
options.C: “lamp 1 and lamp 2” would apply to a different process or organism
options.D: No — “lamp 1 and lamp 2” is not lamps light

followup.why: Option C used “lamp 1 and lamp 2”; the item needs “lamp 1 only”.

D.pathway: swapping the sibling term “neither lamp 1 nor lamp 2” for the required “lamp 1 only”

followup.stem: Option D. Is “neither lamp 1 nor lamp 2” lamps light?

options.A: Yes — “neither lamp 1 nor lamp 2” is lamps light
options.B: “neither lamp 1 nor lamp 2” is a different quantity or structure in the same item
options.C: “neither lamp 1 nor lamp 2” would apply to a different process or organism
options.D: No — “neither lamp 1 nor lamp 2” is not lamps light

followup.why: Option D used “neither lamp 1 nor lamp 2”; the item needs “lamp 1 only”.
